label: No application of a rule, and no…, from An application of a rule is DETERMINED_2… and 1 more
meaning: The shape of the regress in PU §§198, 201 (#1010). If every item, an application of a rule or an interpretation of it, is determined only through a determined interpretation of it, and there is no endless chain of interpretations, then nothing is determined: the paradox of §201's first sentence. The fork theorem in the same config (regressFork) shows that the two premises are inconsistent with STMT-SOME-RULE-APPLICATION-DETERMINED, so a reader must give up one of the three: the diagnostic reading of §201 gives up the interpretation premise (STMT-PU-SOME-GRASP-OF-RULE-NOT-INTERPRETATION), Kripke's sceptic (as reported, STMT-KRIPKE-NO-FACT-OF-MEANING) denies factual determination, which this vocabulary maps, unattributed, to giving up STMT-SOME-RULE-APPLICATION-DETERMINED, and an endless regress gives up finiteness. Each premise is needed (needsOnlyThroughInterpretation, needsNoEndless). The result attributes neither premise to Wittgenstein and settles no reading (DISAMB-RULE-FOLLOWING-PARADOX). Off the root routes.
